title: Great Zoo
text:
It was a great experience 
Zoo is located in central Barcelona set in a beautiful park 
Nice and easy as always 
Zoo is nice and large 
Very clean 
Highly recommend
author: Graeme_R

title: Good day out
text: Very good with a wide range of animals and extremely informative would recommend to future visitors.
author: Phil_H

title: Excellent visit
text: Excellent just as you would expect - good weather too which makes a big difference. One of the best zoos I have been to
author: Sean_T

title: The animals
text: The zoo is beautiful. And safe for children. You can see animals. Too bad you don't see predators
author: Marina L

title: Amazing
text: Went last year and can honestly say it's the best zoo we've ever been to! Going back to Barcelona this month and will definitely be back
author: Passenger812927

title: The ticket is expensive but worth it
text: The zoo is immense, huge, visit it and you will not regret it, especially if you have children! Animals of almost all species, very nice!
author: azzubottici

title: Queued for our ticket and got it with...
text: Queued for our ticket and got it with no problems. Zoo was lovely
author: Letitia P

title: Brilliant Zoo, so many animals the...
text: Brilliant Zoo, so many animals the dolphin and sea lion shows were brilliant.
author: carlyhazell

title: Huge zoo full of so many different...
text: Huge zoo full of so many different species. It's one of the best zoos I've ever visited.
author: Emma L

title: Me and my sons had a fantastic day...
text: Me and my sons had a fantastic day at the zoo. The weather was beautiful and lots of fun and laughs were had. Would recommend a visit to anyone especially as the zoo is set in a beautiful park with lots of additional fun to be had.
author: lisaau82
